$comment: The single source of truth for what version Still ships. Edit here, then run: node scripts/release/version.mjs sync. 'extension' feeds the Chrome and Firefox packages. 'apple' feeds the Apple apps and the Safari extension. 'appleBuild' is the App Store build number: it only ever goes up and is never reset, even when 'apple' changes. See docs/release/versioning-and-packages.md.
